title: Tracking Check
meta: A hands-on check that purchases and leads are counted correctly across your ads and analytics. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Ad tracking check for sales and leads
overview: If your tracking is wrong, every ad decision is wrong. We test your site the way a customer uses it, then compare what your ad platforms and analytics record against your real orders or leads. We look for double counting, missing events, wrong values and broken consent settings. You receive a plain report of what is correct, what is not, and the fixes in order of importance.

faq: Meta pixel, Google Ads, Google Analytics and tag manager, TikTok pixel and common store apps. If you use something else, tell us and we confirm before starting.
If you agree, yes. We can use a test product or a discount code you provide, and we tell you the order numbers so you can cancel or refund them straight away.
Why do platform numbers never match my store exactly?
Some difference is normal because of attribution windows, consent choices and blocked scripts. We separate normal gaps from real errors, and explain which numbers you can trust for decisions.
Can you fix what you find?
On the Premium package we make up to five fixes inside your accounts. On the smaller packages we give you a precise fix list, and you can order the fixes as an add-on.
